pages.text: A $(item)Four-Aspect Signal$() is a three-light signal with a second yellow lamp: it shows $(l)double yellow$() while the next signal on is yellow, as well as yellow while it's red. Trains pass a double yellow at no more than 80 km/h (a server setting), then the yellow at caution speed, ready to stop.$(br2)For fast lines, where trains need more warning.
Double yellow, yellow and red, a train beyond the red; and double yellow close up.
The gauges show two yellow lamps ahead. A comparator reads 15, 7, 3 or 0 for red, yellow, double yellow or green.$(br2)Trains remember the caution they passed, through saving the world too.
